purpose: Visual evidence for the SPE-08 addendum (S1-S4). These four findings had aggregate JSON but NO figure; every existing figure predates the addendum and shows the OLD wording.

figures.shows: Panel 1 is the previously absent control: identical input + identical RNG reproduces the baseline exactly, max diff 0.0 in 20/20 repeats. Panels 2-3 then show the permutation arm alone: |Dlogit| mean-max 0.0828, |Drisk| mean-max 0.0455, cohort max 0.1346 / 0.0748.
figures.evidence_that: the risk difference IS attributable to the permutation, because the same-RNG same-input arm is identically zero while the permutation arm is not
figures.known_limitation: the permutation arm changes which patches win top-k, so this figure bounds a COMPOSITE patch-permutation effect; it does NOT separate pure ordering from a change in the selected patch set. See PROGRESS P6 caveat.

figures.shows: Panel 1: all 28 unordered slot pairs have cohort-mean cosine 0.9968-0.9976, every one above 0.95. Panel 2: the 0.95 threshold is met by 28/28 pairs in 100% of 77 patients; the 0.99 threshold by only 4/28. Panel 3: the residual after removing the shared component still has max off-diagonal cosine 0.978 and residual/mean norm 0.0499.
figures.evidence_that: the 'at least one pair' wording understated the result (it is 28/28 in 77/77), and simultaneously shows why 'the 8 slots are literal copies' is NOT supported
figures.known_limitation: cohort-mean and per-patient max are the summary statistics; the full per-patient 28-pair matrix is server-side only (not in the public aggregate).

figures.shows: Panel 1: after a synchronised slot permutation applied BEFORE top-k, |Dlogit| per-patient max spans 0.00412-0.07744 (median 0.0195, mean 0.0248) and 77/77 patients move above 1e-6. Panel 2: the per-patient effect spans about 360x (risk 0.000138 to 0.04992).
figures.evidence_that: the full model is NOT slot-permutation invariant, reversing the earlier '~1e-7, permutation invariant' reading which described only the mean-aggregation path
figures.known_limitation: this is a mechanism/mechanism-visibility result. It is NOT a patient-harm claim and NOT a performance claim.

figures.shows: C(risk) = 0.7221 [0.7129, 0.7296] versus C(-risk) = 0.2779 [0.2704, 0.2871] over 20 repeats and 77 patients; gap 0.4443.
figures.evidence_that: the producer's sign convention puts higher risk scores earlier events, so upstream 'risk increased / decreased' language can be read literally
figures.known_limitation: the figure deliberately prints comparable_pairs = [] in red. The recorded evidence_for_correct_sign = true is produced alongside an EMPTY comparable-pair list, so the pair count backing this C-index was not captured. This must be resolved before S4 is treated as fully verified.

open_defects_found_while_drawing.finding: S1 arm (b) permutes the patch sequence, but SlotSPE selects patches with Gumbel-noised top-k. Permuting the sequence therefore also changes WHICH patches are selected. The recorded 0.0455 / 0.0748 is a composite 'patch permutation' effect, not a pure ordering effect.
open_defects_found_while_drawing.why_it_matters: the earlier P6 concern was that the difference could not be attributed to order. It is now attributable to the permutation, but 'order' and 'selection-set change' are still not separated.
open_defects_found_while_drawing.would_require: a further eval-only run with a selection-set-preserving control. Not done; not authorised.

open_defects_found_while_drawing.finding: S4 records comparable_pairs = [] while also recording evidence_for_correct_sign = true. Either the pair counter is never populated, or the comparable-pair rule yielded nothing and the C-index came from a different path.
open_defects_found_while_drawing.why_it_matters: the C-index direction check is the foundation for reading every 'risk increased/decreased' statement in S1 and S3.
open_defects_found_while_drawing.would_require: reading the _concordance helper in scripts/server_diagnostics/_s2026_1020_addendum.py and re-deriving the pair count offline from eval_repeats.json. No training or forward pass needed.

open_defects_found_while_drawing.finding: scripts/server_diagnostics/_spe09_viz.server-original.py:444 still contains the patient identifier TCGA-2F-A9KO inside a published caption.
open_defects_found_while_drawing.why_it_matters: P7 from the previous problem list is unresolved; the original file is in the public repository.
open_defects_found_while_drawing.would_require: redacting the caption in the original copy or withdrawing it from the public path.
